def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    for color in range(10):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==color]
        if not cells: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        # A solid rectangular outline: fill its interior with 2.
        if r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2 and all(g[r][c]==color for r,c in [(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]+[(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]+[(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]):
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if g[r][c] != color: g[r][c]=2
    # center of 3x3 color-6 motif becomes 7
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==6]
    if cells:
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if r1-r0==2 and c1-c0==2 and g[r0+1][c0+1]!=6: g[r0+1][c0+1]=7
    return g
